scope: Two previously inspected furniture permutations of one floorplan; dependent development evaluation, not new held-out scenes.
common_geometry: Frozen B6 observed instance support, qualified outer orientation, width, box/leg height and absolute layers, with B8 calibrated surface/free discrepancy.
fixed_extent: For unresolved extent, max(0.65 m, acquired lower span); directly observed opposing endpoints retain their measured span. Keep the same unobserved-position allocation nodes and their observation update as the uncertainty arm.
mean_collapse: Compute full S joint distribution once. For each structure retain its marginal probability and collapse geometry to conditional expected extent and lower endpoint. Do not recompute class likelihood or weights after collapse.
old_controls: O8 results may be shown as historical references only; they are not equivalent to the new fixed-depth control.
paired_conditions: Use original shared sensor prefix, renderer, mapper, observation labels, candidate generation, score coefficients, navigation and 256 paid-action/return protocol. Record already observed initial coverage separately.
fixed_replay: Reuse exactly the six original prefixes and 66 acquired candidate branches. Report absolute supported and realized prediction weight, rank, selected object/global surface increments, coverage gain and action/path cost. No precision-only promotion and no requirement that S wins.
progression: First require valid probability/invariance/source-isolation tests and validation plus held-out informative-view equal-object CRPS improvements over prior-only and fixed-0.65 baselines, including all declared fallback cases. Then audit the full fixed replay for absolute reward support and decision consequences before any new closed loop.
calibration_failure_handling: Missing/multiple/unusable tracks remain explicit inference failures. Evaluator uses public unconditional prior as a sigma-independent fallback for complete denominators, with fixed world-y target extent if no valid inferred axis. No truth-based best-track selection; report failures and valid-only results alongside full-cohort results. This does not calibrate a complete tracking pipeline.
preserve: all five arms and both layouts
all failures, interventions and negative effects
original source and previous frozen records
avoid: counting views or repeated prefixes as independent objects
